Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy cherry-red PVC catsuit with long sleeves and matching PVC gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless cherry-red PVC hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the PVC: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto the heavy timber threshold across the floor of the same doorway, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart. Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy PVC hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a hint of despair, her eyes softly worried and shining, her brow lightly drawn together, makeup: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
